instruction: Look at task-003_initial.scad. Make a linear carriage block centered on the origin with an overall bounding size of 100 x 46 x 24 mm (x=-50..50, y=-23..23, z=0..24). Create two parallel rounded rail clearance slots. Each slot is a 72 x 6 mm capsule centered at (0,-13) or (0,13): its end-arc radius is 3 mm, its left and right arc centers are (-33,-13)/(33,-13) or (-33,13)/(33,13), and the arcs run counterclockwise from 90 to 270 degrees on the left and from -90 to 90 degrees on the right, with straight tangent edges joining them. Extrude both slot profiles vertically from z=0 through z=20. Create four vertical through M5 clearance holes of diameter 5 mm, centered at every combination of x=+/-38 and y=+/-16, extending from z=0 to z=24. Add a rectangular central pad with outer bounds x=-40..40 and y=-15..15, extending from z=18 to z=19.5. Preserve crisp reference-outline corners at all eight coordinate combinations (x,y,z)=(+/-42,+/-21,0 or 24); these are reference-outline corners inside the overall x=+/-50, y=+/-23 bounding faces. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-003_output.stl. Do not create PNG, PDF, CSV, JSON, or any other extra output.
